method: Darwin clonefile(2) with CLONE_NOFOLLOW, CLONE_ACL and CLONE_NOFOLLOW_ANY. Verified clone in a unique sibling path, then atomically replaced only the historical worktree pathname.
local_primary_source: Darwin man 2 clonefile and active Command Line Tools SDK sys/clonefile.h
eligibility: Same-volume single-link regular files >= 4096 bytes. Identical regular-file blobs in HEAD and index at both paths, with an exact on-disk SHA-1 Git blob and matching SHA-256 for both. Dirty paths, untracked paths, symlinks and Scout 117 paths excluded. Same-mode/owner/group/flags/ACL/xattrs verified. Current worktree mtime and atime copied to the temporary clone.
verification: Primary source and worktree target stat and SHA-256 checked before replacement, temporary clone and installed target verified, ACLs and extended attribute values compared without recording their contents. Visible open paths screened with lsof. Point-in-time file checks depend on owner confirmation that historical artifacts are closed.
limitations: The APFS volume is shared with concurrent runs and other local activity. Available-space delta is observed, and can include unrelated writes, reclaim, and snapshots. Former inode block counts are not exclusive recovery measurements.

New inode identity and change time follow normal filesystem replacement semantics. The source path was never opened for writing. Read access and background processes can affect atime; primary atime is excluded from identity comparison.
This measurement covers the two named isolated worktrees only.
manifest_verification: Independently rechecked path uniqueness, owner prefixes, regular files, same volume, single link counts, distinct inodes, lengths, and worktree mtime across all rows. Recomputed matching SHA-256 on both sides for a deterministic sample of 24 rows.
